song: Young Thug - Money on Money (feat. Future), 0:00-1:00
style: surreal money chaos x cinematic luxury flex; anamorphic, 35mm grain, night, teal/pink/gold grade

shots.key: Empty wet downtown Atlanta street at night, neon reflections, thousands of hundred-dollar bills falling UPWARD into the sky, LEAD standing in the middle of the road looking up, low-angle wide
shots.move: slow crane up following the bills rising, bills flutter upward

shots.key: Luxury penthouse at night with floor-to-ceiling windows over city skyline, the room flooded waist-deep with cash like water, LEAD standing still in it, pink fur coat, chains glinting
shots.move: slow push-in, waves of cash ripple around him

shots.key: Matte pink supercar (no logos) drifting on a wet night highway, trunk open, a storm of cash blasting out behind it, LEAD visible through window
shots.move: fast tracking shot alongside the drift, bills explode toward camera

shots.key: Extreme macro close-up of LEAD's stacked diamond chains and iced grill smile, light refracting into rainbow sparkles, cash counter machine blur in foreground
shots.move: quick rack focus from money counter to diamonds, sparkle flares

shots.key: Private jet cabin, cream leather, a swirling vortex of cash inside the cabin, LEAD lounging calmly in the seat with sunglasses
shots.move: slow orbit around LEAD as cash swirls in a tornado

shots.key: Massive tornado made entirely of dollar bills touching down over downtown Atlanta skyline at night, lightning, tiny silhouette of LEAD on a rooftop in front
shots.move: epic slow push toward the tornado

shots.key: Endless gold vault corridor, walls stacked floor-to-ceiling with gold bars and cash bricks, LEAD walking toward camera, symmetrical
shots.move: steady dolly backward as he walks forward, confident strut

shots.key: Rooftop infinity pool filled with cash instead of water, night skyline, LEAD mid-air cannonballing in, bills splashing up
shots.move: slow motion splash, cash sprays toward camera

shots.key: Dark recording studio filled with red smoke, FEATURE in black leather trench coat and frozen Cuban link, sitting on a stack of cash bricks, red neon
shots.move: slow push-in, smoke drifting, he leans forward

shots.key: A skyscraper built entirely from stacked cash bricks rising above the city, LEAD and FEATURE standing on the very top, wind blowing coats
shots.move: fast drone rise from street level to the top, revealing them

shots.key: Black helicopter landing on a helipad at night, rotor downwash blasting a whirlwind of cash, FEATURE stepping out, LEAD waiting
shots.move: handheld low angle, bills whip past the lens

shots.key: Infinite mirror maze, dozens of reflections of LEAD each fanning out stacks of hundreds, pink and gold lighting
shots.move: slow sideways slide revealing endless reflections

shots.key: Cloud of dollar bills over the city at sunset morphing into a flock of birds, LEAD on a balcony arms spread
shots.move: bills transform into birds flying across frame, camera tilts up

shots.key: Solid gold luxury sedan (no logos) parked on a dark street, melting into liquid gold that pools across the asphalt, LEAD and FEATURE leaning on it
shots.move: slow push-in as the gold melts and drips

shots.key: LEAD and FEATURE on giant thrones made of cash bricks in a dark marble palace, gold light shafts, piles of money everywhere
shots.move: slow pull-back reveal, then cash bursts upward from the piles
